title: Run-level replicate: re-run baseline condition a second time, all else fixed

cost.note: LOCAL models only (google/gemma-4-e2b, nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni) via LM Studio on Carey's Mac. Zero API spend — the cost is ~3.5h of the machine's GPU and electricity, not credits. Verified from the model column of both sealed CSVs.

why: Only experiment that can un-provisional the causal sentence live on intellectualresistance.com. Literature (2506.09501, 2601.19934, 2604.22411) documents temp-0 across-run drift EXISTS but reports no magnitude for a fixed local model on a fixed bank — this run measures that magnitude in items. AMENDED 2026-07-28 after CS-003: fix batch size and seed and record both per run. That isolates the same residual arXiv:2601.19934 isolates (batch size 1, seeds fixed, still 0.093 unique-output fraction at temp 0), so our number sits beside a published one on the same mechanism. Zero extra cost — two settings, not more calls. Conditional on LM Studio exposing them; if not, record what they were. CONFIRMED (Hermes, 2026-07-28): executor already fixes eval_batch_size=4096, physical_batch_size=1024. Seed accepted by LM Studio at /api/v0/chat/completions but does NOT control kernel-level nondeterminism at temp 0 (residual is hardware FP ordering, not sampling). The comparison to published work is on batch-fixed terms; seed recorded per run for provenance but not expected to control the residual. COST CORRECTION 2026-07-28: this was carried as credits-gated. It is not — both runs used local LM Studio models, so there is no API bill; the only cost is machine time.

why: Ran in-house on arXiv rather than paying an external service.
